notes:
Remote Client 0.2.0

- Added EC2 Instance Connect for Linux SSH with Auto, Public, and Private Endpoint routes, plus EC2 Serial Console recovery terminals for Linux and Windows.
- Added reliable Serial Console cleanup when tabs close, preventing active-session limit errors.
- Saved credentials can now be reused across Windows and Linux.
- Managed private-key copies are now encrypted at rest and materialized only temporarily when connecting.
- AWS SSO sign-in can now be cancelled immediately and retried without waiting for a timeout.
- Added an action to stop all running instances in a VPC.
- Fixed in-app Remote Desktop key repeat and preserved display scaling when the window is resized. Initial scaling now follows the Windows display setting.
- Background Remote Desktop sessions now stay renderer-synchronized so they display correctly when revisited.
- Fixed profile saves and deletions so unrelated profiles are no longer revalidated or affected.
- Added a full-screen mode with an auto-hiding title bar for a more immersive workspace.
- Remote Desktop and SSH terminal tabs can now be moved into separate windows and merged back without reconnecting, enabling multi-monitor workflows.
- Added light mode, plus an Auto setting that follows the operating system appearance.
- Clarified Other profile setup by renaming Method to Connection Type.
